result.result:
I added a "Dark mode" checkbox to the settings page, gated by a new `dark_mode` flag that defaults to `false`. The edits are in `web/settings.js` and `flags.json`, and `npm test` passes (3/3). The ui-rules house rules applied: sentence-case label, escaped user values, and reuse of the existing `button` helper. The checkbox is not a `<button>`, so it has no `data-track`, matching the `beta_search` control in `search.js`.

The toggle is hidden until `dark_mode` is set to `true`. Nothing applies the dark theme yet, so the checkbox doesn't change anything. The missing test is one that checks the toggle appears only when `dark_mode` is on. It belongs in `test/settings.test.js`, which is outside my owned paths, so I didn't add it. I haven't committed.

status: done — the feature is in place and tests pass; the dark-mode test and the theme itself are not part of this change.
